sloka: पतिव्रतात्वमास्थाय रामं कृत्वा सदा हृदि ।श्रेयस्ते परमं देवि तथा कृत्वा भविष्यति ।। ७.४७.१८ ।।
transliteration: pativratātvamāsthāya rāmaṁ kṛtvā sadā hṛdi ।śreyaste paramaṁ devi tathā kṛtvā bhaviṣyati ।। 7.47.18 ।।

translations.english: O goddess, by adopting the state of a devoted wife and always keeping Rama in your heart, your supreme welfare will be achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 47 ।। Thus ends the forty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
